Note: Duration of treatment (week) is defined as the time from the date of first dose to the date of last dose. 
Cumulative dose (mg) is the sum of ‘Actual total daily dose’ × (End date- Start date+1) per record. Total planned dose 
(mg) is the sum of ‘Planned total daily dose’ × (End date- Start date+1) per record. Compliance is 100*(Cumulative 
dose/Total planned dose), accounting for planned dose modifications and interruptions. Absolute dose intensity 
(mg/week)is (Cumulative Dose (mg))/(Duration of Treatment (week)). Relative dose intesity (%) is (Absolute Dose 
Intensity (mg/week))/(Initial Planned  Weekly Dose (mg/week), 1400 for ARV-471 and 7 for Anastrozole)).
